name: patient_has_symptoms_of_asthma_finding_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has symptoms of asthma.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has symptoms of asthma.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have symptoms of asthma.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has symptoms of asthma.

name: patient_is_exposed_to_corticosteroid_series_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever (prior or current) been exposed to corticosteroids via inhaled route.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever (prior or current) been exposed to corticosteroids, specifically via inhaled route.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never been exposed to corticosteroids via inhaled route.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever been exposed to corticosteroids via inhaled route.

name: patient_is_exposed_to_corticosteroid_series_inthehistory@@route_inhaled
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's exposure to corticosteroids was via the inhaled route.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's exposure to corticosteroids was via the inhaled route.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's exposure to corticosteroids was not via the inhaled route.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the exposure to corticosteroids was via the inhaled route.

name: patient_is_exposed_to_corticosteroid_series_inthehistory@@route_oral
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's exposure to corticosteroids was via the oral route.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's exposure to corticosteroids was via the oral route.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's exposure to corticosteroids was not via the oral route.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the exposure to corticosteroids was via the oral route.

name: patient_has_finding_of_febrile_respiratory_infection_recently
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has had a febrile respiratory infection recently.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has had a febrile respiratory infection recently.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has not had a febrile respiratory infection recently.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has had a febrile respiratory infection recently.

name: patient_has_finding_of_asthma_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has asthma.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the clinical finding of asthma.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of asthma.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of asthma.

name: patient_has_finding_of_asthma_now@@unstable
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current asthma is unstable.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has asthma and the asthma is unstable.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently has asthma and the asthma is not unstable.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's current asthma is unstable.

name: patient_has_finding_of_severe_asthma_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has severe asthma.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the clinical finding of severe asthma.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of severe asthma.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of severe asthma.
